_note: Why a rival club said no, passed or outbid you (P-18). One sentence per reason code; the code is chosen where the club's decision is made (Contracts.evaluate_trade, GameState._wont_go and _trade_assets, Contracts.prefers_why, Draft._best_ai_pick), never worked out afterwards. Placeholders: {club} the rival, {player} the player, {other} the player it took instead, {pos} a position in words, {age} his age, {to} the clubs he asked for, {n} a list size, {gap} how far ahead of your pick ("two picks before yours"). No percentages, values or hidden ratings.

reasons.trade_empty: Put a player or a pick on each side.
reasons.trade_closed: Trades are open in the off-season and on draft night.
reasons.trade_night_picks_only: On draft night only picks change hands: the lists are closed.
reasons.trade_twice: Each player or pick can only go in once.
reasons.trade_not_their_pick: That pick isn't theirs to trade.
reasons.trade_not_your_pick: That pick isn't yours to trade.
reasons.trade_not_their_player: That player isn't on their list.
reasons.trade_not_your_player: That player isn't on your list.
reasons.trade_list_over: That would take a list past {n} players.
reasons.trade_list_under: That would take a list below {n} players.
reasons.trade_their_cap: {club} said no: they can't fit the salary under their cap.
reasons.trade_your_cap: You can't fit the salary under your cap.
reasons.trade_rebuild_future: {club} said no: they are rebuilding, and {player} is part of their future.
reasons.trade_no_game: {club} said no: {player} wouldn't get a game in their side.
reasons.trade_value_close: {club} said no: your offer is a little short of what they give up.
reasons.trade_value_gap: {club} said no: they would be giving up more than they get back.
reasons.fa_wants_senior_football: {player} turned you down: he wouldn't make your best 23, and a club that would play him has made an offer.
reasons.fa_money: {club} paid more: {player} took the bigger offer.
reasons.fa_role: {player} chose {club}: they offered him a clearer path into their best 23.
reasons.fa_security: {player} chose {club}: they offered him more seasons.
reasons.fa_push: {player} chose {club}: they are pushing to win now.
reasons.fa_first: {player} chose {club}: their offer was the same as yours and came first.
reasons.fa_your_cap: {player} chose {club}: you no longer had the cap room for your offer.
reasons.draft_must_ruck: {club} passed on {player}: they had to take a ruck, and every list needs two.
reasons.draft_cap: {club} passed on {player}: they couldn't fit his price under their cap.
reasons.draft_ruck_full: {club} passed on {player}: they already have three rucks.
reasons.draft_first_ruck: {club} passed on {player}: they already have their first-choice ruck.
reasons.draft_stocked: {club} passed on {player}: they are well stocked with {pos} and went for {other}.
reasons.draft_price: {club} passed on {player}: his price would have squeezed the rest of their list.
reasons.draft_took_best: {club} took {player} {gap}: he was the best left on their board.
